name: Nachi
source:
Job: Your cat
Type of Ayakashi: Nekomata Cat Spirit
Signature Trait: Can transform into a cat. Has two tails.
Likes: Sardines
Dislikes: Water

Known by the heroine as her beloved cat "Tama," this Ayakashi has actually been alive for well over a millennium. His naivete and boyish charms often make him the butt of the group's jokes, much to his chagrin. However, he possess an unassailable spirit that always lifts the heroine up when she's feeling down...

[From [url=https://voltageapps.com/ayakashi/characters/detail-night-nachi]English official site[/url]]
